title: Always-on AI agent: what it means, with an example
description: An always-on AI agent keeps working when you are not at your computer: it runs on a machine that stays on. What that means in practice, with a real example.
keywords: what is an always on ai agent
answer: an always-on ai agent keeps doing its job when you're not around: routines at set times, reactions to new mail, answers to your phone at 2am. the trick isn't the ai. it's where the agent runs. it needs a computer that never sleeps, and your laptop isn't one.
og_line: what it means, with an example.
definition: an ai that keeps working on its own schedule, on a computer that stays on, so it doesn't stop when you close your laptop.
example:
a bot has the routine "every weekday at 7, summarise what came into #support overnight".

- **on a sleeping laptop:** nothing at 7. a run missed by less than 12 hours runs once when you open it.
- **on [dusk cloud](/docs/dusk-cloud):** it runs at 7 sharp, and the summary is on your phone when you wake.

same ai, same bot. only the computer changed.

sections.md:
**not an ai that thinks all day.** it mostly waits, and uses your ai plan when it has work to do. a bot with lots of routines uses more.

not a special model either. claude, chatgpt, gemini and the rest can all power one. "always on" is about the computer underneath: a spare machine, a rented server, or a hosted one like dusk cloud.

- **routine:** a job a bot does on a schedule or when something happens. see [scheduled ai tasks](/scheduled-ai-tasks).
- **background agent:** often the same idea, sometimes just an agent in a tab you aren't watching. that one still stops when the computer sleeps.
- **cloud computer:** a computer someone hosts for you. the usual home for an always-on agent.
